navigation.description:
Navigation slot — inject a NavigationRail, NavDrawer, or custom nav.
 Shown on the side at lg+, hidden below it (use mobileNavigation for mobile).

mobileNavigation.description:
Mobile navigation slot — how `navigation` translates below lg (it's
 hidden there). With the "bottom" variant, inject a horizontal
 NavigationRail to mirror the side rail as a bottom-nav pill. With
 "drawer", this is the drawer's content — omit it to reuse `navigation`.

mobileNavigationVariant.description:
How mobile navigation is hosted below lg:
 - `"bottom"` (default) — mobileNavigation pinned to the content area's
   bottom edge as a bar.
 - `"drawer"` — a menu button opens mobileNavigation (or `navigation`
   when not set) as a modal slide-in drawer.

appSwitcher.description: App switcher slot — positioned top-left after nav area

sidebarWidthPersistence.description:
Injected server-side sidebar-width persistence (docs 12.4 + 13b). When
 wired, the rail width becomes ONE shared per-user value across every
 platform host (read on mount, written on resize-end through the host's
 shared agent client) instead of per-origin localStorage. Omit it for
 in-memory-only width — Storybook and pre-migration hosts keep working,
 width just doesn't persist.

open.description:
Controlled sidebar open/closed. Wire it to the host's persisted session
 open flag (`useAgentSession().open`) so a reload repaints the sidebar in
 the state the user left it — without it the shell derives visibility from
 width alone and always paints closed on reload. When `true` while the
 width is still 0 (fresh open, or restored-open before the width fetch
 lands) the shell seeds the width from the remembered/~30%-viewport size;
 when `false` while open it collapses to 0. Omit it (undefined) to keep the
 uncontrolled width-derived behavior unchanged.

onOpenChange.description:
Called whenever the user opens or closes the sidebar (toggle, close,
 FAB). Pair with `open` to persist the flag — e.g.
 `useAgentSession().setOpen`.

appSwitcherClassName.description: Class for the app switcher container

navClassName.description: Class for the navigation wrapper (override responsive visibility)

snackbarClassName.description: Class for the snackbar container (e.g. max-w-2xl mx-auto)

agentEmptyState.description:
Personalized opener shown in the agent body when no `agentSidebarContent`
 is wired (e.g. before any conversation exists) — typically a host
 greeting like "Hi, Sam, ask me anything about this app". Re-exports the
 inner `AgentSidebarMessages` `emptyState` slot so a host that renders the
 list itself and one that lets the shell render it agree on the same type.
 Undefined-safe: omit it and the body falls back to `agentSidebarContent`.

hideAgentEmptyStateLogo.description:
Hide the MirrorStack logo the shell paints above `agentEmptyState`.
 Defaults to false (logo shown) — mirrors the inner
 `AgentSidebarMessages` `hideEmptyStateLogo`, so a host that lets the shell
 render the opener gets the same branded hero as one rendering the list
 itself. No-op when `agentEmptyState` is omitted.

agentHistory.description: Past conversations grouped by date — shown in the agent header history dropdown.

agentTabs.description:
Controlled tab list for the agent header. Provide together with
 activeAgentTabId/onSelectAgentTab/onCloseAgentTab/onNewAgentTab; omit all
 five to keep the header's internal uncontrolled tab state.

onSelectAgentTab.description: Called when the user clicks an agent tab. Consumer updates activeAgentTabId.

onCloseAgentTab.description: Called when the user clicks the X on an agent tab. Consumer removes it from agentTabs.

onNewAgentTab.description: Called when the user clicks + or the overflow "New chat" entry. Consumer appends a tab.

onRenameAgentConversation.description:
Enables the hover rename affordance on agent history rows.
 Called with the trimmed title (1-200 chars) when the user commits an inline rename.

onDeleteAgentConversation.description:
Enables the hover delete affordance on agent history rows. Clicking it
 opens a destructive confirmation dialog first; this fires only once the
 user confirms (cancel/dismiss does nothing).

agentHeaderLabels.description:
Label overrides for the agent header (history, rename, new-chat, and the
 delete-confirmation dialog strings). All have EN defaults.

agentQueuedMessages.description:
Messages waiting to send once the current reply finishes — rendered as
 cancellable rows above the agent input, in send order. Display-only:
 queueing logic lives in the consumer.

onCancelAgentQueued.description: Called with the queued row's id when its X is clicked.

agentPendingContent.description:
Slot pinned directly above the agent input — used for messages the user
 sent while the agent was still responding (queued input). Stays in view
 with the input even when the messages list scrolls.

agentModels.description: Model roster for the agent input's model selector — omitted = no selector.

agentInputPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the agent input textarea. Default: "Type a message..."

agentInputLabels.description:
Label overrides for the agent input (queued-message strings).

thresholdY.description:

 dashed line itself always renders). Omit for no threshold.

stories.name: Open On Hover
stories.description: `openOnHover` opens the menu on mouse hover of the trigger, layered on top of click. The menu stays open while the pointer is over the trigger or the menu, and closes after a short grace on leave so trigger→menu travel does not dismiss it. Mouse-only — touch/pen keep tap-to-toggle. Reach for it on a desktop toolbar overflow menu, never a mobile bottom-nav menu. Hover over the button below to open it.

stories.name: Tight Head
stories.description: The notch head tuned to a small trigger: `notchWidth`/`notchHeight` size the tab to the icon button, and `notchRadius`/`notchInverseRadius` round the head down to the button's own corner radius instead of the default bulbous 16.

offset.description: Horizontal offset from trigger. Positive = from start (left), negative = from end (right)

notchWidth.description: Width of the notch tab (SVG units). Default `52`.

notchHeight.description: Height of the notch tab (SVG units). Default `46`.

notchRadius.description:
Corner radius of the notch outline (SVG units). Default `12`. Lower it to
 match a small trigger's own radius for a less-rounded head (e.g. an icon
 button with an 8px radius).

notchInverseRadius.description:
Radius of the notch's inverse (concave) corners, where the tab curves back
 into the card (SVG units). Default `10`. Usually scaled down alongside
 `notchRadius` for a tighter head.

notchStrokeWidth.description: Stroke (border) width of the notch outline, in px. Default `1.5`.

useNotch.description:
Render the kit's signature notch wrapping the trigger. Default `true`. Set
 to `false` for a plain floating menu (e.g. selects, period pickers).

placement.description:
Which side of the trigger the menu opens toward. `"top"` opens upward —
 use it for triggers anchored to the bottom of the viewport (e.g. a mobile
 bottom nav), where a downward menu would fall off-screen. Default `"bottom"`.

size.description:
Item density. `"lg"` enlarges padding, text, and icons to comfortable
 touch targets — use it for menus opened on touch surfaces (e.g. a mobile
 bottom nav). `"md"` is the default desktop density.

openOnHover.description:
Open the menu on mouse hover of the trigger, in addition to click.
 The menu stays open while the pointer is over the trigger OR the floating
 menu, and closes after a short grace on leave so trigger->menu travel does
 not dismiss it. Mouse-only: no-op on touch/pen (which keep tap-to-toggle)
 and for keyboard. Default `false` — hover menus hurt touch and keyboard
 discoverability, so opt in deliberately (e.g. a desktop toolbar overflow
 menu, not a mobile bottom-nav menu).

 COUPLING NOTE: relies on the menu rendering INLINE inside `containerRef`
 (no portal). If DropdownMenu ever moves to a portal, hover-leave detection
 must be reworked (the menu would no longer be a container descendant).

menuClassName.description:
Class applied to the floating menu element (the notched card) — use it to
 fine-tune the menu's position relative to the trigger, e.g. a translate
 to nudge the whole notched card off the auto-aligned anchor.

Sub Items
stories.description: Sub-items inside a single themed panel. The panel's footprint is the union of the sub-items' masks (so notches appear where no sub-cell sits).

stories.name: Draggable
stories.description: Outer-grid drag over rich notched footprints: grab any top-level tile (L-hero, plus, chart, diagonal, panel) and drop it on another cell — it pins and everything else re-flows. `onItemMove` reports the new `[col, row]`. Sub-items in the panel are draggable too: drag a sub-cell within the panel to reposition it, or drag it *out* past the panel to promote it to a standalone top-level tile (`onSubItemMove` / `onSubItemPromote`). Dragging the whole panel chrome by its gaps + adjacency auto-link land in PR 6.

cols.description:
Column count, or `"auto"` (default) to derive from container width via
 the gain-1-col rule.

blockMin.description:
Minimum block size in px when `cols="auto"`. The grid gains a column
 each time the container can fit one more `blockMin`. Default 96.

gap.description: Gap between blocks in px (notch erosion). Default 8.

contentPad.description:
CSS padding inset on each tile / sub-cell's content. Default `"16px 8px"`.
 Lower it (or `0`) for fine-resolution grids where a tile may be only a
 fraction of a block tall — the default would over-pad short cells.

panelBleed.description:
Expand each panel's outline OUTWARD by `panelBleed` px so its frame can sit
 beyond the cells — lets the outer frame match the inter-tile gap instead of
 being half of it. Pair with a `contentPad` of the same value for uniform
 spacing. Default 0.

nest.description: Reserved — already implied by the solver's cell-level collision.

primitives.description:
Map from `ui.type` → React component. Receives the full `ui` object as
 props. Unknown types fire `onItemError` and render a placeholder so the
 layout doesn't collapse.

draggable.description: Enable outer-grid drag-to-place AND sub-item drag + promote.

onItemMove.description: Called after an outer tile drops, with its new block position.

onSubItemPromote.description:
